Build kit for "Button - Icon"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
The idea is a part of a page and names no page, so it starts from the app shell. Scaffold it, then put blocks inside it.

name:        shell-top-nav
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template shell-top-nav --type page <path>

Install missing dependencies: npm install @heroicons/react@"^2.2.0"

This template uses StyleX. Your project needs a StyleX compiler plugin - see `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs styling-overview` for setup steps.

BLOCKS
Ready-made sections for parts the template lacks (top 3 of 5; --verbose for all). Print one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template <name>

name:        ButtonWithIcon
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Buttons with a leading icon that reinforces the label.

name:        IconButtonTooltipIconButton
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Icon buttons with tooltips that explain each action on hover

name:        IconButtonShowcase
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: An icon button with a wrench icon.

COMPONENTS
For what the template and blocks do not cover (top 3 of 6; --verbose for all). Read one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 component <name>

name:        IconButton
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: A button that shows only an icon with no visible text.

name:        InfoTip
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: An info icon that reveals help: a small "i" button.

name:        useInputContainer
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Makes an input container wrapper clickable, delegating focus to the inner input/textarea when the user clicks non-interactive areas (icons, padding, status indicators).

frame:      AppShell, TopNav, SideNav, Layout
foundation: VStack, HStack, Grid, StackItem, Card, Section, Text, Heading, Button, Icon, Badge, Divider
